summary: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing an EGM to approve a private placement of 14,000,000 new ordinary shares at KRW 1,600 per share, raising KRW 22.4 billion (~HKD 113.6 million). Proceeds are allocated to working capital, marketing, and R&D. The board recommends approval, with subscribers including Wang Tingfeng, Wong Sio Chan, and Rui Xing International. Shares are subject to a one-year lock-up and delivered through KSD. The ESG is a rights-style issuance to specific investors.
